name: indentyl
description: Colourised indentation guides that stay correct on every platform. Uses your file's real tab size, diagnoses mixed tabs and spaces, and updates in 0.5ms inside a 12,000-line file. No telemetry.

indentyl.colors.markdownDescription: Colours cycled across indent levels. Any CSS colour works: `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, or a VS Code theme colour id such as `editorIndentGuide.background`.

indentyl.colorsLight.markdownDescription: Overrides `#indentyl.colors#` in light themes. Empty means use `#indentyl.colors#`.

indentyl.colorsHighContrast.markdownDescription: Overrides `#indentyl.colors#` in high-contrast themes, where the default translucent fills are too faint to see.

indentyl.errorColor.description: Colour for an indent that is not a whole number of indent units.

indentyl.tabmixColor.description: Colour for indentation that mixes tabs and spaces against the file's own indent style.

indentyl.opacity.markdownDescription: Multiplier applied to the alpha of every colour above. `1` uses the colours as written; `0.5` halves their strength.

enumDescriptions: Draw a thin vertical rule at the start of each indent unit.
indentyl.style.description: How an indent unit is drawn.

indentyl.detectErrors.description: Highlight indentation that does not match the file's indent style: tabs in a space-indented file, spaces before tabs in a tab-indented file, and indents that are not a whole number of indent units.

indentyl.ignoreErrorLanguages.markdownDescription: Languages where indentation is free-form and error highlighting is noise. `*` disables error highlighting everywhere.

indentyl.ignoreErrorsInBlockComments.description: Do not report indent errors inside block comments and multi-line strings, where alignment is deliberate prose rather than code indentation. Level colours are still drawn there.

indentyl.ignoreLinePatterns.markdownDescription: Regular expressions. A line matching any of them gets no decoration at all. Example: `["^\\s*//"]`.

indentyl.includedLanguages.description: If non-empty, only these language ids are decorated.

indentyl.colorEmptyLines.description: Carry the surrounding indentation across blank lines.

indentyl.renderMarginLines.markdownDescription: How many lines above and below the visible area are decorated in advance. Larger values make fast scrolling smoother and cost more work per update.

indentyl.maxDecorationsPerEditor.description: Hard cap on decorations applied to one editor in a single update. A safety valve for pathological files; the visible area is always well inside it.

indentyl.updateDelayMs.description: Debounce for redecorating after an edit, a scroll, or a selection change.

indentyl.maxIndentColumns.description: Stop analysing a line's indentation after this many columns. Protects against machine-generated files with enormous leading whitespace.

indentyl.maxBlockCommentScanLines.description: Largest file, in lines, for which block-comment regions are tracked. Beyond this, level colours are still drawn but errors inside block comments are no longer suppressed.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run bundle && npm run compile-tests && node --test "out/test/*.test.js"
